name: memory_save
description: 保存一条长期记忆到记忆宫殿。当你发现值得跨会话记住的信息时调用：用户的稳定偏好、关键决策及理由、项目重要约束、踩过的坑、被验证有效的方案。hall 分类：decision=决策、event=事件、discovery=发现、preference=偏好、suggestion=建议。preference/suggestion 自动存入全局 user 翼；其余存入当前项目翼。
description_en: Save a long-term memory to the memory palace. Call when you find information worth remembering across sessions: stable user preferences, key decisions with rationale, important project constraints, pitfalls encountered, validated solutions. hall categories: decision, event, discovery, preference, suggestion. preference/suggestion go to the global 'user' wing; others go to the current project wing.

room.description: 主题房间名（英文小写连字符，如 context-engine、api-design、deployment；同类主题保持同名以形成关联）
room.description_en: Topic room name (lowercase hyphenated, e.g. context-engine, api-design, deployment; keep same name for related topics to form tunnels)

verbatim.description: 对话中的原文片段（保留关键原话，供追溯）
verbatim.description_en: Original text fragment from the conversation (keep key verbatim quotes for traceability)

insight.description: 一句话洞察（将来注入上下文的内容，要自包含、无歧义）
insight.description_en: One-sentence insight (this is what gets injected into future contexts; make it self-contained and unambiguous)

importance.description: 重要性 0-1（>=0.75 进入关键事实常驻层；默认 0.5）
importance.description_en: Importance 0-1 (>=0.75 enters the always-on key facts layer; default 0.5)
